critique: The background is a solid dark color, lacking any dynamic elements or visual interest.
The HUD is functional but lacks distinctiveness; the score and health indicators could benefit from more contrast against the background.
There is no indication of player action or interaction; the frame does not convey a sense of engagement or excitement.
priorityFixes: Add a dynamic background or animated elements to enhance visual interest.
Increase the contrast of the HUD elements by using brighter colors or outlines to improve readability.
Introduce visual feedback for player actions, such as particle effects or animations, to suggest engagement.
